visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a high ponytail and a white t-shirt stands in front of a Vieshow Cinemas entrance, holding a large blue rabbit plushie and waving at the camera with a bright smile. (2) She turns and walks towards an escalator, with a brown leather bag slung over her shoulder; the background shows modern mall architecture and bright lighting. (3) The scene shifts to an event registration desk where she is handed a large poster by a staff member in a black mask; the lighting is warm and indoor. (4) She moves to a large photo wall area with life-size cutouts of a male celebrity (Cha Eun-woo) and various promotional banners for a 'VR Concert'. (5) Close-up shots of the promotional poster featuring the celebrity and a display table with merchandise like canned drinks and small cards are shown under bright studio-style lighting. (6) The woman interacts playfully with the cardboard cutouts, pretending to be shy or leaning against them, while holding her blue plushie and the poster. (7) A wide shot shows a screen displaying a poster for 'Cha Eun-woo VR Concert Memories', followed by the woman waving excitedly again in front of the photo zone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the 'Cha Eun-woo VR Concert Memories' event held at Vieshow Cinemas. It aims to generate excitement and encourage fans to experience the VR concert by showcasing the venue, the check-in process, exclusive merchandise, and the interactive fan zones.
